Date 2024-08-05

Eligibility Requirements:

Undergraduate students in their 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year, and graduate students in their 1st or 2nd year of this department. (For the 113th academic year, meaning those enrolled as undergraduates in years 2–4 or graduate students in years 1–2.)

Conduct grade A, with an average academic score of 80 or above in the previous semester, and no failing grades.

Actively participate in international exchange activities, Japanese language competitions on or off campus, or demonstrate outstanding service performance.

Must have taken courses offered by the department in the previous semester.

Ineligible to Apply:

Those planning to study abroad for one month or longer during the scholarship period.

Those who have received or are currently receiving full-time employee salary income prior to or during the selection period.

Those who plan to receive full-time employee salary income during the scholarship period.

Required Application Documents:

Scholarship application form (see attachment).

Complete academic transcripts.

Undergraduate students: study plan for the scholarship period; graduate students: research proposal and three course reports.

Other supporting documents beneficial for review (e.g., language certificates, volunteer service proofs, award certificates).

For more details, please refer to the National Chengchi University Nitori International Scholarship Implementation Guidelines.

Date 2024-08-29

For students who applied for the minor program in or before Academic Year 112 (including 112):

Please note that “Japanese Reading(1)” and “Japanese Listening” are required courses for minor students starting from Academic Year 113.

Students who applied in or before Academic Year 112 should continue to take “Elementary Japanese” and “Studies in Japanese Language (1).”

The availability of “Elementary Japanese” and “Studies in Japanese Language (1)” will gradually decrease over the years. By Academic Year 114, only one class will remain. If you do not have scheduling conflicts this year, please make full use of this opportunity.

For students applying for the minor program in Academic Year 113:

Since “Japanese Reading(1)” and “Japanese Listening” have reached full capacity, the following alternatives apply:

Japanese Reading(1)： Can be exempted by taking university foreign language courses (Japanese) or the minor’s elementary Japanese course, or by passing the Japanese proficiency test (please refer to the FAQ on the department’s website).

Japanese Listening: An additional class will be offered on Fridays during periods 7 and 8. Students who have not yet been enrolled in this course are advised to prioritize selecting this time slot to ensure sufficient enrollment. If this is not possible, no further add approvals will be granted by other instructors.

Please note that add-slip printing for all Japanese department courses is not open. Students must download the add-slip from the department website under “Information Zone” → “Download Area” → “Undergraduate.” (Add-slips should only be submitted to the department office during the official add/drop period; early submissions will not be accepted.)

Minor students selecting elective courses within the department are required to pay full tuition fees for auditing classes. For details, please refer to the “Academic Year 113 Expanded Minor Program Tuition Recovery Criteria”.

text:

日期：2019-01-17

發文字號： 政總字第1080001302號

主 旨： 更正有關本校107學年度第2學期註冊繳費事項，詳如說明，請惠予轉知學生務必於108年3月4日前繳納，請查照。

登載日期： 108/01/14

登載期限： 108/01/21

承辦人員： 郭小綾

承辦單位： 總務處出納組

內 容： 一、更正本校108年1月10日政總字第1080001130A號函本學年度第2學期註冊繳費期限。

二、本學年度第2學期註冊繳費單於108年1月28日當天起即可上網列印繳費。可由本校首頁點選在校學生，進入「學雜（分）費繳費專區」中自行下載列印，網址：http://moltke.cc.nccu.edu.tw/…/index.jsp或由第一銀行第e學雜費入口網選擇學校及…。網址：https://eschool.firstbank.com.tw/member/index.aspx。繳款方式請參照繳費單說明之方法辦理繳費。

三、學生於繳費完成隔日，可直接於本校首頁點選在校學生，進入「學雜（分）費繳費專區」線上列印繳費證明，使用信用卡繳費者，則需於繳費成功後4個工作天才可線上列印繳費證明，使用超商繳費者，則需於繳費成功後6~7個工作天才可線上列印繳費證明。

四、註冊繳費期限至108年3月4日止，逾期銀行將不再受理收費，未繳費同學需持註冊繳費單至體育館1樓出納組綜合業務櫃台繳交註冊費用。未於期限內完成註冊者視為延誤註冊，將依國立政治大學「學則第十三條」之規定辦理。第十三條:學生應於每學期規定期限內繳納各種費用並完成註冊通知單規定之各項手續。延誤註冊逾二週仍未完成註冊繳費，未逾第四十一條所定休學年限者即令休學，其餘即令退學。但有特殊事由經書面向教務處專案申請核准者，不在此限。

五、事關學生權益，敬請利用 貴學系（所）公告欄、網站或電子郵件信箱，廣為週知。
